views.name: team_reference_clean
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  id AS team_id,
  market AS market,
  alias AS alias,
  name AS team_name,
  code_ncaa AS code_ncaa,
  kaggle_team_id AS kaggle_team_id,
  school_ncaa AS school_ncaa,
  turner_name AS turner_name,
  league_name AS league_name,
  league_alias AS league_alias,
  league_id AS league_id,
  conf_name AS conf_name,
  conf_alias AS conf_alias,
  conf_id AS conf_id,
  division_name AS division_name,
  division_alias AS division_alias,
  division_id AS division_id,
  venue_id AS venue_id,
  venue_name AS venue_name,
  venue_city AS venue_city,
  venue_state AS venue_state,
  venue_address AS venue_address,
  venue_zip AS venue_zip,
  venue_country AS venue_country,
  venue_capacity AS venue_capacity,
  logo_large AS logo_large,
  logo_medium AS logo_medium,
  logo_small AS logo_small
FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_teams`
views.description: Normalized team reference table: one row per team from mbb_teams with canonical id, market, alias, conf and venue attributes. Use to join descriptive team attributes to game facts or to display team metadata. | Use for: Enrich game rows with team metadata; List teams by conference or venue capacity; Map team ids to display names/logos

views.name: games_team_boxscore_facts
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  game_id,
  season,
  scheduled_date,
  gametime,
  status,
  coverage,
  neutral_site,
  conference_game,
  tournament,
  tournament_round,
  venue_id,
  venue_city,
  venue_state,
  home_team,
  team_id,
  market AS team_market,
  alias AS team_alias,
  name AS team_name,
  opp_id AS opp_team_id,
  opp_market AS opp_market,
  opp_alias AS opp_alias,
  opp_name AS opp_name,
  win,
  points_game,
  field_goals_made,
  field_goals_att,
  three_points_made,
  three_points_att,
  two_points_made,
  two_points_att,
  free_throws_made,
  free_throws_att,
  rebounds,
  offensive_rebounds,
  defensive_rebounds,
  assists,
  turnovers,
  steals,
  blocks,
  personal_fouls,
  minutes,
  points AS total_points,
  team_turnovers,
  team_rebounds,
  opp_points_game,
  opp_rebounds,
  opp_assists,
  opp_turnovers,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(field_goals_made, NULLIF(field_goals_att,0)) AS field_goal_rate,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(three_points_made, NULLIF(three_points_att,0)) AS three_point_rate,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(two_points_made, NULLIF(two_points_att,0)) AS two_point_rate,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(free_throws_made, NULLIF(free_throws_att,0)) AS free_throw_rate,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(assists, NULLIF(turnovers,0)) AS assist_to_turnover_ratio_from_counts,
  created
FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_teams_games_sr`
grain: game_id, team_id — one row per team's boxscore in a single game (same as mbb_teams_games_sr)
views.description: Pre-aggregated team-game-level facts and basic derived rates from mbb_teams_games_sr. One row per team-boxscore (same grain as source) exposing common measures and simple computed rates to simplify downstream queries. | Use for: Compute season/game level team summaries and trends; Compare team vs opponent boxscore stats; Filter team performances by conference/venue and compute aggregated metrics

views.name: team_game_winrank_running
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  game_id,
  team_id,
  scheduled_date,
  gametime,
  season,
  home_team,
  points_game,
  win,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY team_id, season ORDER BY gametime, scheduled_date, game_id) AS season_game_number,
  SUM(points_game) OVER (PARTITION BY team_id, season ORDER BY gametime, scheduled_date, game_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_points_in_season,
  SUM(CASE WHEN win THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY team_id, season ORDER BY gametime, scheduled_date, game_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_wins_in_season
FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_teams_games_sr`
grain: game_id, team_id — one row per team's boxscore with sequential season game number and running totals
views.description: Per-team running game sequence with game-level rank and running totals. One row per team-game identical to mbb_teams_games_sr but with season-game_number (rank by gametime) and cumulative sums for points and wins to support top-K/time-series questions and running aggregates. | Use for: Compute per-team streaks or cumulative season stats; Select top-K games by season_game_number or get first/last N games per team; Plot running totals or compute moving averages per team
